author: DickyChant
body: #### PR description: `HGCalGeometry::getClosestCell()` loops over every module of a subdetector (O(1e4) silicon wafers, O(1e5) scintillator tiles) on each call. That made it the dominant cost of HGCAL fast simulation, while FullSim never uses it: FullSim takes the layer from the G4 volume hierarchy and inverts the cell with `HGCalDDDConstants`. This PR adds `HGCalFastGeometry` to `FastSimulation/CaloGeometryTools`. It maps (layer, x, y, zside) to an HGCAL DetId without that loop. - **Silicon (CE-E, CE-H).** At construction it builds a per-layer bucket grid of the cassette-shifted wafer centres, one bucket per wafer pitch, using only the DDD constants. A lookup checks the 3x3 neighbouring buckets for the nearest wafer centre, which on a hexagonal lattice is the containing wafer. It then passes that wafer to `HGCalDDDConstants::waferFromPosition()` for the same analytic cell inversion FullSim uses. - **Scintillator.** Tiles go through `assignCellTrap()`, with tile type, SiPM and granularity set exactly as in `SimG4CMS/Calo` `HGCalNumberingScheme`. - **Footprint.** It is built in ~1 ms per subdetector, takes about 0.33 MB per job for both silicon subdetectors, and is const and shareable across streams. - **Output changes.** None. No producer uses the class yet. The follow-up HGCAL GFlash FastSim PR will use it, including `siThicknessType()` and `simWeight()`. *Schematic: D110 CE-E layer 1 with its real wafer centres and the class's own bucket grid; GFlash-like spots are looked up through the 3x3 buckets, with `getClosestCell()` paced at its measured cost per call next to it. The cells are drawn schematically.* The calorimeter-entry design follows Jan Eysermans' 2021 HGCAL FastSim demonstrator and has been recently discussed in Phase 2 FastSIM meetings. #### PR validation: Builds with latest IB without issues, and tested against D110 geometry well. | geometry | CE-E Si | CE-H Si | CE-H scintillator | |---|---|---|---| | D110 (v17) | 0 mismatches, 545 | 0 mismatches, 462 | 0 mismatches | Studies with latest D122 geometry ongoing. #### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for: No back port needed (so far)
title: [Phase-II FastSIM] Add a FastGeometry for HGCAL
